descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje pentru automatizări
We are Bertrandt : an independent, international development service provider with long years of automotive expertise. We create technological solutions for our customers at any stage of the product development process with a focus on hot topics such as digitalization, e-mobility and autonomous systems, largely for the automotive, aerospace and mechanical engineering sectors.
 Our goal: accelerating technological progress. We work on this every day – with around 13,000 employees at over 50 sites worldwide.
 What to expect: 
Collect, process, analyze and interpret data from multiple sources to support business and project-related decisions
Extract and transform data from different systems and ensure data quality, consistency and completeness
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and data visualizations to monitor key performance indicators and business performance
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies and opportunities through structured data analysis
Translate business requirements into analytical solutions, reports and actionable insights
Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand reporting needs and define relevant KPIs and metrics
Monitor data quality and investigate discrepancies, inconsistencies and anomalies
Prepare regular and ad-hoc reports for different stakeholders and management levels
Automate recurring reporting and data preparation activities where possible
Maintain and improve existing dashboards, reports and analytical processes
Support data-driven decision making by providing clear conclusions and recommendations based on analysis
Document data sources, reporting logic, processes and analytical methodologies
Collaborate with IT, business, engineering and other internal teams to improve data availability and reporting processes
Participate in meetings with project teams and stakeholders to present findings, discuss results and clarify requirements
Identify opportunities for process optimization and improved data utilization
 What you bring along: 
At least 2 years of experience in data analysis, reporting or a similar analytical role
Technical or analytical background, preferably in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or a related field
Strong experience with SQL for data extraction, transformation and analysis
Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools such as Power BI or Tableau
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions and data analysis
Understanding of data quality, data validation and data preparation processes
Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources
Ability to identify trends, anomalies and relationships within data
Experience translating business requirements into KPIs, reports and analytical solutions
Basic understanding of data modeling and relational databases
Experience with Python or another programming language for data analysis and automation is a plus
Experience with automotive or engineering-related data is a plus
Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities and deadlines
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
Ability to communicate complex data insights in a clear and structured way
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams
Advanced English, written and spoken
 What we offer: 
Flexible work environment
Private health insurance with optional medical packages for you and your family.
24 vacation days, increasing to 25 days after 3+ years with us.
Meal tickets and Holiday vouchers.
Bookster and 7Card subscription.
